title: The native channel round trip: channel_write_read (0x1013) to a waiting echo server and back

as_of.note: steps 1 to 4, ERAPS, VZEROALL, the DS/ES and FS/GS skips and object cuts 1 and 2 on main; J, user inlining, cut 3, Q1-Q8 and F-65's fix in flight; 9.12 (the direct resume) on os76/fastpath-v2, its premise disproved by the unwind-inline entry

definition.entry: the client's SYSCALL of channel_write_read (0x1013) in ferrix_rt's x86-64 stub
definition.exit: the client's next instruction after SYSRET with the server's echo in its return registers
definition.direction: one side's entry into 0x1013 to the other side's return from its own 0x1013; a round trip is two directions

figure.ab_command: cargo xtask bench-ipc --release --accel kvm --smp 1 --arch x86_64 --init ~/.local/share/ferrix/busybox/{arch}/bin/busybox.static --alternate main --rounds 5 --record
figure.gated: matched: every mitigation on, both programs in one speculation domain, against seL4 with the same protections (customer, 2026-10-02)
reported_not_gated: call (outside a domain, with the switch barrier)
IBPB at every switch on both kernels
figure.target: under 400 ns p50 matched on nazuna (customer, 2026-10-06); seL4 matched is 440 ns, 400-410 without its refill
figure.pin: host processor 11 (bench-ipc's default where the host has more than 12)
